_comment: Phase 2 (2026-10-06): phase1_v4 controller (pitch/altitude PID + heading hold, same task, scenarios and weights) + Flight Dynamics' flex v2 structure block (structure_v2: the 12 genes of flexbody.gene_schema(), built at load time so the encoding tracks FD's spec; flex.asymmetric adds FD's 2 optional asymmetry genes). Constraints: conservative minimum over bodies and methods of flutter / divergence / reversal margins (capped at 3, not-found = cap): < 1.0 not flown (cost 2000), 1.0-1.2 hinge^2 penalty (in 'fd' mode: FD's margins and FD's J_*_margin terms inside structural_v2). Structural objective structural_v2 = FD's flexeval structural cost (struct_v2_source 'fd': all FD J_* terms at FD's weights, FD's gate; struct_v2_w_peak/rms are used only by the 'genome' A/B source) (DESIGN.md 3c). Generation 0 seeded near the structural baseline (init, sigma 0.10). ki_alt upper bound 0.5 (v5 bound, phase2-only override; the shared v4 bound stays 0.05). Aligned with Evolution Runner's phase2_pilot (2026-10-06 08:35). Use --aircraft c172x | t38 | b737. flex.asymmetric stays false until lateral/roll scenarios exist. Mass exploit: fixed on FD's side (§12: minimum-gauge mass floor + pre-flight limit-load sizing terms, included in structural_v2 with FD's weights); the interim tail/fuselage mass-credit clip used 08:00-08:15 MST is off (struct_v2_mass_credit_clip, A/B only). Fidelity: full (flexbody v2, hard gate 1.0).
name: phase2_flex
